definitions.name: O1C.DELTA
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 1 -1 '([' C SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT
definitions.note: Bracket character string to 1 when it opens a bracket, -1 when it closes one.

definitions.name: O1C.REDUCE
definitions.body: 'S' BIND 0 5 RANGE S [ 'E' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: String to its reduced form after deleting adjacent () and [] pairs (six rounds cover twelve characters).

definitions.name: O1C.SHIFT
definitions.body: 'X' BIND 1 COLLECT X X LENGTH 1 SUB TAKE CONCAT
definitions.note: s X to the Vector [ s ] followed by X without its last element (each element's predecessor).

definitions.name: O1C.PREV
definitions.note: Vector to the predecessor of each position; the first position is its own predecessor.

definitions.name: O1C.RUNIDS
definitions.body: 'X' BIND X X O1C.PREV SUB [ 'D' BIND 1 0 D 0 EQ NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 1 PUT 0 [ ADD ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector to the 1-based index of the maximal run of equal adjacent values each position belongs to.

definitions.name: O1C.MEDIAN
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V SORT 'S' BIND S V LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S V LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even).

definitions.name: O1C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'L' BIND L [ 0 GET ] MAP L [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries to a Record from each name to the sum of its amounts, first-appearance order.

solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ O1C.DELTA ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: 'S' BIND S CHARS 'C' BIND 0 C LENGTH RANGE [ 'K' BIND C K TAKE JOIN O1C.REDUCE '' EQ ] FILTER 0 [ MAX ] FOLD

solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'L' BIND L L [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET

solutions.messy.sorted_unique: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP UNIQUE SORT G0B.SPACED

solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.rle: 'X' BIND X O1C.RUNIDS X GROUP VALUES [ 'V' BIND V 0 GET V LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
solutions.runs.upruns: 'X' BIND X X O1C.PREV SUB [ 'D' BIND 0 1 D 0 GT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 'I' BIND I X GROUP VALUES [ LENGTH ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.dedupe: 'X' BIND X O1C.RUNIDS X GROUP VALUES [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.runs.majority: 'X' BIND X TALLY 'R' BIND R G0A.TOPKEY 'K' BIND K NIL R K GET 2 MUL X LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.sensor.filled: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET 'F' BIND V F [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND E A E NIL? NOT SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ 'E' BIND 1 0 E NIL? SELECT ] MAP 'F' BIND F 0 F O1C.SHIFT SUB 0 MAX G0A.SUM
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ 'E' BIND 1 0 E NIL? SELECT ] MAP 0 [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD E MUL ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'V' BIND V [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER G0C.MAXV 'M' BIND V M DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V O1C.MEDIAN 'M' BIND V M SUB 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX O1C.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
